item.title: Exploring the Library’s Photography Books
item.description: I love reading photography books. item.title: Impact Story: When a Children’s Author Comes to Town
item.description: The benefits of reading for kids are well-known: literacy, language skills, empathy. But on a winter morning at Seattle’s John Rogers Elementary, a group of 40 fourth and fifth grade readers are showing something else: pure, unadulterated excitement.
